semver-sorter.name: Semantic Version Sorter
semver-sorter.description: Sort release tags using SemVer 2.0 precedence and find the highest stable version.

meta.title: Semantic Version Sorter
meta.description: Sort release tags using SemVer 2.0 precedence and find the highest stable version.
meta.keywords: semver sorter, semantic versions, release tags, prerelease, version order

semverSorter.hint: Enter up to {limit} versions and {characters} characters. Blank lines and surrounding whitespace are ignored. Use major.minor.patch with optional prerelease and build metadata.
semverSorter.emptyResult: Enter versions and sort to see the result.
semverSorter.rules: SemVer 2.0: prereleases precede the matching stable release; numeric identifiers sort numerically, others by ASCII. Build metadata does not affect precedence. Equal versions and duplicates retain input order and original tags. Version ranges are not supported.
semverSorter.invalid: Line {line} is not a valid SemVer version. Use major.minor.patch; numeric identifiers must not have leading zeros.
semverSorter.versionLimit: Use at most {limit} non-empty version lines.
